content:
Production capacity plan failed due to a floating-point precision error in the backlog buffer calculation for Week 6.
The execution failed at test_plan_math_and_policy in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, Week 6 triggered an AssertionError: 'end backlog formula mismatch' because abs(202.2 - 202.21000000000004) resulted in 0.010000000000047748, exceeding the 0.01 tolerance. While the initial Week 4 conditions and demand matching passed, the carryover logic or capacity subtraction introduced a precision drift.
